summary: Iteration 125: Draft Products Feature Testing. All 22 backend tests passed. Draft products correctly appear in seller's business tools (listings, dashboard, invoices, composite products) but are excluded from public search and product pages.

frontend_issues.notes: Backend-only testing as requested. No frontend testing performed.

✓ GET /api/business-tools/invoice-products returns all products including draft

✓ invoice_router.py uses status:{$in:['active','paused','draft']} for invoice products

seed_data_creation: Used existing listings: 69b57c730ed7999c085b3656 (now draft after test), 69b5c25c2972a896e0a78417 (draft), 69b57c730ed7999c085b3657 (active)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 125 tested the draft products feature. Key findings: (1) All seller-side business tool routers (home, invoice, composite_products, export_import, reports, panel) now include draft status in queries: status:{$in:['active','paused','draft']}. (2) Public-facing endpoints (search, enterprise_products) correctly use status:'active' only, excluding draft products. (3) Unpublish endpoint (POST /api/listings/{id}/unpublish) works correctly for active->draft. (4) Publish endpoint requires email verification. (5) Test listings: 69b57c730ed7999c085b3656 and 69b5c25c2972a896e0a78417 are now in draft status, 69b57c730ed7999c085b3657 is active. (6) Note: Running unpublish tests may change listing status - publish requires email/GST verification to restore.
features_tested: Draft products appear in seller's own listings (GET /api/seller/listings)
Draft products counted in dashboard summary (GET /api/business-tools/home/summary)
Draft products appear in invoice products (GET /api/business-tools/invoice-products)
Draft products appear in composite products (GET /api/business-tools/composite-products)
Draft products do NOT appear in public search (GET /api/search)
Draft products do NOT appear in public product pages (enterprise_products)
Active products still work normally in all endpoints
